name: Gmail — Read
author: hearth-team
description: Read-only Gmail access via Google OAuth. Search your inbox, read message bodies, list labels. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.readonly scope — this skill physically cannot send mail or modify your mailbox. Pair with Gmail — Send for outbound.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: From your Google Cloud project (APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs). Shared across all Google Workspace skills — same client for Gmail Read, Gmail Send, Google Calendar, etc.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: Paired with the client ID above. Stored encrypted in your vault.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail read refresh token
vault_inputs.help: Obtained via the OAuth consent flow with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`. Generate at https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground (paste your client ID/secret, select Gmail API v1 → gmail.readonly, exchange for refresh token).
